mapper.select: SELECT id, name, code, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at FROM industry_chain WHERE is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT c.id, c.name, c.code, COALESCE(node_stats.node_count, 0) AS node_count, COALESCE(ent_stats.enterprise_count, 0) AS enterprise_count FROM industry_chain c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT chain_id, COUNT(*) AS node_count FROM chain_node WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY chain_id ) node_stats ON c.id = node_stats.chain_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT cn.chain_id, COUNT(DISTINCT en.enterprise_id) AS enterprise_count FROM enterprise_node en INNER JOIN chain_node cn ON en.node_id = cn.id AND cn.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY cn.chain_id ) ent_stats ON c.id = ent_stats.chain_id WHERE c.id = #{chainId} AND c.is_deleted = 0
